| | ## Semantic DOM ## 主题变量（Design Token）{#design-token} ## FAQ ### onChange 时如何获得父节点信息？ {#faq-parent-node-info} 从性能角度考虑，我们默认不透出父节点信息。你可以这样获得： ### 自定义 Option 样式导致滚动异常怎么办？ {#faq-custom-option-scroll} 请参考 Select 的 [FAQ](/components/select-cn)。 ### 为何在搜索时 `loadData` 不会触发展开？ {#faq-load-data-expand} 在 v4 alpha 版本中，默认在搜索时亦会进行搜索。但是经反馈，在输入时会快速阻塞网络。因而改为搜索不触发 `loadData`。但是你仍然可以通过 `filterTreeNode` 处理异步加载逻辑： ```tsx { const match = YOUR_LOGIC_HERE; if (match && !treeNode.isLeaf && !treeNode.children) { // Do some loading logic } return match; }} /> ``` ### 为何弹出框不能横向滚动？ {#faq-popup-not-scroll} 关闭虚拟滚动即可，因为开启虚拟滚动时无法准确的测量完整列表的 `scrollWidth`。

demos.name: maxCount
demos.title: Max Count
demos.description: You can set the `maxCount` prop to control the max number of items can be selected. When the limit is exceeded, the options will become disabled.

demos.name: placement
demos.title: Placement
demos.description: You can manually specify the position of the popup via `placement`.

demos.name: status
demos.title: Status
demos.description: Add status to TreeSelect with `status`, which could be `error` or `warning`.

demos.name: style-class
demos.title: Custom semantic dom styling
demos.description: You can customize the [semantic dom](#semantic-dom) style of TreeSelect by passing objects/functions through `classNames` and `styles`.

demos.name: treeData
demos.title: Generate from tree data
demos.description: The tree structure can be populated using `treeData` property. This is a quick and easy way to provide the tree content.

demos.name: treeLine
demos.title: Show Tree Line
demos.description: Use `treeLine` to show the line style.

demos.name: variant
demos.title: Variants
demos.description: Variants of TreeSelect, there are four variants: `outlined` `filled` `borderless` and `underlined`.
